---
title: "Table theme registry"
description: "Every surveyed table theme: the source it copies, its dark policy, a preview, and the call for gt and reactable."
output: html_document
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(sdvplotR)
```

sdvplotR ships one table theme for each of 122 surveyed sources, named after the
source: `datagolf`, `basketball-reference`, `wikipedia`, `nejm`. The same
registry is read by sdvplot (Python) and sdvtables (JavaScript), so a name means
the same table in every language. The list below is built from
`sdv_table_themes()` when this article is knit, so it cannot drift from the
package.

```{r, eval = FALSE}
gt_object |> gt_theme_source("datagolf")             # a gt table
gt_object |> gt_theme_source("datagolf", mode = "dark")
reactable::reactable(df, theme = reactable_theme_sdv("datagolf"))
```

Lookup runs through the house themes, then the 27 reactablefmtr ports (bare
names such as `espn`), then the registry (`espn-site` is the site's own look).
`mode = "dark"` works for themes whose dark policy is `native` (measured) or
`derived` (from the light palette); on a `none` theme it raises, naming three
dark-capable themes in the same category.

```{r, results = "asis", echo = FALSE}
img <- "https://plot.sportsdataverse.org/img/table-themes"
th <- sdv_table_themes()
for (cat in sort(unique(th$category))) {
  rows <- th[th$category == cat, ]
  cat("\n\n## ", cat, " (", nrow(rows), ")\n\n", sep = "")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    id <- rows$id[i]
    cat("### `", id, "`\n\n", rows$source[i], ", dark: ", rows$dark_policy[i], "\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("<img src=\"", img, "/", id, "-light.webp\" alt=\"", rows$source[i],
        " table theme, light\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"480\"> ", sep = "")
    if (rows$dark_policy[i] != "none") {
      cat("<img src=\"", img, "/", id, "-dark.webp\" alt=\"", rows$source[i],
          " table theme, dark\" loading=\"lazy\" width=\"480\">", sep = "")
    }
    cat("\n\n`gt_theme_source(gt, \"", id, "\")` &middot; `reactable_theme_sdv(\"", id, "\")`\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
